+ 
+ library TestUtils {
+     // Test constants
+     uint24 constant FEE = 3000; // 0.3%

+ 
+     function deployHook(MockPoolManager poolManager) internal returns (AutoRebalanceHook) {
+         uint24 flags = uint24(
+             Hooks.AFTER_INITIALIZE_FLAG |
+             Hooks.BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG |
+             Hooks.AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG |
+             Hooks.BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG |
+             Hooks.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG
+         );
+ 
+         bytes memory creationCode = type(AutoRebalanceHook).creationCode;
+         bytes memory constructorArgs = abi.encode(IPoolManager(address(poolManager)));
+ 
+         (address hookAddress, bytes32 salt) = HookMiner.find(
+             address(this),
+             flags,
+             creationCode,
+             constructorArgs
+         );
+ 
+         AutoRebalanceHook hook = new AutoRebalanceHook{salt: salt}(IPoolManager(address(poolManager)));
+         require(address(hook) == hookAddress, "Hook address mismatch");
+         
+         return hook;
+     }
+ 
+     function createPoolKey(
+         address token0,
+         address token1,
+         IHooks hooks
+     ) internal pure returns (PoolKey memory) {
+         return PoolKey({
+             currency0: Currency.wrap(token0),
+             currency1: Currency.wrap(token1),
+             fee: FEE,
+             tickSpacing: TICK_SPACING,
+             hooks: hooks
+         });
+     }
+ 
+     function deployTokens() internal returns (MockERC20 usdc, MockERC20 eure, MockERC20 wbtc) {
+         usdc = new MockERC20("USD Coin", "USDC", 6);
+         eure = new MockERC20("Euro Stablecoin", "EURE", 6);
+         wbtc = new MockERC20("Wrapped Bitcoin", "WBTC", 8);
+ 
+         // Ensure token ordering
+         if (address(eure) < address(usdc)) {
+             (eure, usdc) = (usdc, eure);
+         }
+         if (address(wbtc) < address(usdc)) {
+             (wbtc, usdc) = (usdc, wbtc);
+         }
+     }
+ }

+ // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+ pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+ 
+ import "forge-std/Test.sol";
+ import {AutoRebalanceLibrary} from "../../src/libraries/AutoRebalanceLibrary.sol";
+ import {TickMath} from "v4-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol";
+ 
+ contract AutoRebalanceLibraryTest is Test {
+     // Test constants
+     uint256 constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;
+ 
+     function test_CalculateOptimalRange() public {
+         // Test case 1: Normal volatility for non-stable pair
+         (int24 lowerTick, int24 upperTick) = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateOptimalRange(
+             0, // Current tick at 0 (1:1 price)
+             120, // Base range of 120 ticks (~1%)
+             500, // 5% volatility
+             false // Not a stable pair
+         );
+         
+         assertLt(lowerTick, 0, "Lower tick should be negative");
+         assertGt(upperTick, 0, "Upper tick should be positive");
+         assertEq(upperTick - lowerTick, 120, "Range should match base range");
+         
+         // Test case 2: High volatility for non-stable pair
+         (lowerTick, upperTick) = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateOptimalRange(
+             0,
+             120,
+             2000, // 20% volatility
+             false
+         );
+         
+         assertGt(upperTick - lowerTick, 120, "Range should expand for high volatility");
+         assertLe(upperTick - lowerTick, 2000, "Range should not exceed max");
+         
+         // Test case 3: Stable pair should maintain tight range
+         (lowerTick, upperTick) = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateOptimalRange(
+             0,
+             20,
+             2000, // High volatility should not affect stable pairs as much
+             true
+         );
+         
+         assertLe(upperTick - lowerTick, 40, "Stable pair should maintain tight range");
+     }
+ 
+     function test_ShouldRebalance() public {
+         // Test case 1: Out of range position should always rebalance
+         bool shouldRebalance = AutoRebalanceLibrary.shouldRebalance(
+             5, // 5% deviation
+             10, // 10% threshold
+             true, // Out of range
+             1 ether, // Fees earned
+             0.1 ether, // Gas cost
+             false // Not stable pair
+         );
+         assertTrue(shouldRebalance, "Should rebalance when out of range");
+         
+         // Test case 2: Stable pair with sufficient fees
+         shouldRebalance = AutoRebalanceLibrary.shouldRebalance(
+             1, // 1% deviation
+             2, // 2% threshold
+             false, // In range
+             1 ether, // High fees
+             0.1 ether, // Low gas cost
+             true // Stable pair
+         );
+         assertTrue(shouldRebalance, "Should rebalance stable pair when fees cover cost");
+         
+         // Test case 3: Volatile pair below threshold
+         shouldRebalance = AutoRebalanceLibrary.shouldRebalance(
+             5, // 5% deviation
+             10, // 10% threshold
+             false, // In range
+             1 ether, // High fees
+             0.1 ether, // Low gas cost
+             false // Not stable pair
+         );
+         assertFalse(shouldRebalance, "Should not rebalance volatile pair below threshold");
+     }
+ 
+     function test_CalculateVolatility() public {
+         uint256[] memory priceHistory = new uint256[](24);
+         
+         // Test case 1: No volatility
+         for(uint i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
+             priceHistory[i] = 1000;
+         }
+         uint256 volatility = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateVolatility(priceHistory);
+         assertEq(volatility, 0, "Should have zero volatility for constant price");
+         
+         // Test case 2: Moderate volatility
+         for(uint i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
+             priceHistory[i] = 1000 + (i % 2) * 100; // Alternating 1000 and 1100
+         }
+         volatility = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateVolatility(priceHistory);
+         assertGt(volatility, 0, "Should detect volatility");
+         assertLt(volatility, 1000, "Volatility should be reasonable");
+         
+         // Test case 3: High volatility
+         for(uint i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
+             priceHistory[i] = 1000 + (i % 2) * 500; // Alternating 1000 and 1500
+         }
+         volatility = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateVolatility(priceHistory);
+         assertGt(volatility, 1000, "Should detect high volatility");
+     }
+ }

Let me analyze the implementation of the `poolMetrics` function and related code:

1. **PoolMetrics Structure**:
The contract defines a `PoolMetrics` struct in `AutoRebalanceHook.sol` that tracks:
```solidity
struct PoolMetrics {
    uint256 lastUpdateTime;   // Last time metrics were updated
    uint256 volumeLast24h;    // Volume in last 24 hours
    uint256 feesLast24h;      // Fees in last 24 hours
    uint256 volatility24h;    // Basis points (1/10000)
    uint256 avgGasPrice;      // Last known gas price in gwei
    int24 lastTick;           // Last known tick
}
```

2. **Metrics Update Logic**:
The metrics are updated in the `_updateMetrics` function which is called after each swap:
```solidity
function _updateMetrics(
    bytes32 poolId,
    int256 amountSpecified,
    BalanceDelta delta,
    int24 currentTick
) internal {
    PoolMetrics storage metrics = poolMetrics[poolId];
    
    // Initialize metrics if first update
    if (metrics.lastUpdateTime == 0) {
        metrics.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp - HOUR;
        metrics.avgGasPrice = block.basefee;
    }
    
    // Update volume safely
    uint256 volume = uint256(amountSpecified < 0 ? -amountSpecified : amountSpecified);
    if (type(uint256).max - metrics.volumeLast24h >= volume) {
        metrics.volumeLast24h += volume;
    }
    
    // Update volatility metrics hourly
    if (block.timestamp >= metrics.lastUpdateTime + HOUR) {
        // Update price history
        if (priceHistory[poolId].length >= PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH) {
            for (uint i = 0; i < PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH - 1; i++) {
                priceHistory[poolId][i] = priceHistory[poolId][i + 1];
            }
            priceHistory[poolId][PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH - 1] = uint256(uint24(currentTick));
        } else {
            priceHistory[poolId].push(uint256(uint24(currentTick)));
        }
        
        // Calculate volatility using library
        metrics.volatility24h = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateVolatility(priceHistory[poolId]);
        
        // Update last values
        metrics.lastTick = currentTick;
        metrics.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp;
        metrics.avgGasPrice = (metrics.avgGasPrice * 9 + block.basefee) / 10;  // EMA of gas price
    }
    
    emit MetricsUpdated(
        poolId,
        metrics.volumeLast24h,
        metrics.feesLast24h,
        metrics.volatility24h,
        metrics.avgGasPrice
    );
}
```

3. **Volatility Calculation**:
The volatility is calculated in `AutoRebalanceLibrary.sol` using a standard deviation approach:
```solidity
function calculateVolatility(uint256[] memory priceHistory) internal pure returns (uint256) {
    if (priceHistory.length < 2) return 0;
    
    uint256 avgPrice;
    uint256 totalDeviation;
    
    // Calculate average price
    for (uint i = 0; i < priceHistory.length; i++) {
        avgPrice += priceHistory[i] / priceHistory.length;
    }
    
    if (avgPrice == 0) return 0;
    
    // Calculate standard deviation
    for (uint i = 0; i < priceHistory.length; i++) {
        uint256 deviation;
        if (priceHistory[i] > avgPrice) {
            deviation = priceHistory[i] - avgPrice;
        } else {
            deviation = avgPrice - priceHistory[i];
        }
        totalDeviation += (deviation * 10000) / avgPrice;
    }
    
    return totalDeviation / priceHistory.length;
}
```

4. **Usage in Rebalancing**:
The metrics are used in the rebalancing logic to:
- Determine if a rebalance is needed based on price deviation and gas costs
- Adjust the position range based on volatility
- Track fees and volume for analytics

5. **Potential Issues**:
1. **Volume Overflow**: While there is a check for overflow when updating volume, it silently fails if overflow would occur. This could lead to underreporting of volume in high-activity pools.

2. **Gas Price EMA**: The gas price EMA uses fixed weights (9/10 old value, 1/10 new value) which might not adapt quickly enough to rapid gas price changes.

3. **Price History Storage**: The price history array has a fixed length of 24 entries. While this is reasonable for 24-hour volatility calculation, it might be memory intensive for pools with frequent updates.

4. **Volatility Calculation**: The volatility calculation uses a simplified standard deviation approach that:
   - Doesn't account for time weighting
   - Could be manipulated by extreme price movements
   - Might not be gas efficient for frequent updates

5. **Fee Tracking**: While `feesLast24h` is part of the struct, I don't see where it's being updated in the code. This appears to be a missing implementation.

6. **Metrics Reset**: There's no mechanism to reset or decay the 24h metrics, which could lead to inaccurate reporting over time.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {BaseHook} from "v4-periphery/src/utils/BaseHook.sol";
import {IPoolManager} from "v4-core/src/interfaces/IPoolManager.sol";
import {PoolKey} from "v4-core/src/types/PoolKey.sol";
import {BalanceDelta} from "v4-core/src/types/BalanceDelta.sol";
import {Hooks} from "v4-core/src/libraries/Hooks.sol";
import {TickMath} from "v4-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol";
import {PoolId, PoolIdLibrary} from "v4-core/src/types/PoolId.sol";
import {Currency} from "v4-core/src/types/Currency.sol";
import {AutoRebalanceLibrary} from "./libraries/AutoRebalanceLibrary.sol";
import {AccessControl} from "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";

/**
 * @title AutoRebalanceHook
 * @notice A hook that automatically rebalances liquidity positions based on price movement and volatility
 * @dev Implements dynamic range adjustment and gas-optimized rebalancing logic
 */
contract AutoRebalanceHook is BaseHook, AccessControl {
    using PoolIdLibrary for PoolKey;

    // Roles
    bytes32 public constant ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256("ADMIN_ROLE");

    // Custom errors
    error Unauthorized();
    error InvalidConfig();
    error FailedToRebalance();
    error InvalidState();

    // Events
    event PositionUpdated(bytes32 indexed poolId, int24 lowerTick, int24 upperTick, uint128 liquidity);
    event RangeReset(bytes32 indexed poolId, int24 newLowerTick, int24 newUpperTick);
    event ConfigUpdated(string name, uint256 oldValue, uint256 newValue);
    event PairConfigSet(bytes32 indexed poolId, bool isStablePair, int24 tickRange, uint256 rebalanceThreshold);

    // Constants
    uint256 private constant HOUR = 3600;
    uint256 private constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;
    uint256 private constant PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH = 24;
    bytes internal constant ZERO_BYTES = bytes("");

    // State variables
    address public owner;
    
    // Default configuration
    uint256 public defaultRebalanceThreshold = 10;    // 10% for non-stable pairs
    int24 public defaultTickRange = 120;              // ~1% for non-stable pairs
    uint256 public defaultCooldownPeriod = 12 hours;  // 12 hours for non-stable pairs
    
    // Stable pair configuration
    uint256 public stableRebalanceThreshold = 2;      // 2% for stable pairs
    int24 public stableTickRange = 20;                // ~0.2% for stable pairs
    uint256 public stableCooldownPeriod = 6 hours;    // 6 hours for stable pairs

    // Position tracking
    struct Position {
        int24 lowerTick;
        int24 upperTick;
        uint128 liquidity;
        uint256 lastRebalance;
        bool active;
    }
    
    struct PairConfig {
        bool isConfigured;
        bool isStablePair;
        int24 tickRange;
        uint256 rebalanceThreshold;
        uint256 cooldownPeriod;
    }
    
    // Pool metrics tracking
    struct PoolMetrics {
        uint256 lastUpdateTime;   // Last time metrics were updated
        uint256 volumeLast24h;    // Volume in last 24 hours
        uint256 feesLast24h;      // Fees in last 24 hours
        uint256 volatility24h;    // Basis points (1/10000)
        uint256 avgGasPrice;      // Last known gas price in gwei
        int24 lastTick;           // Last known tick
    }

    // State mappings
    mapping(bytes32 => Position) public positions;
    mapping(bytes32 => PairConfig) public pairConfigs;
    mapping(bytes32 => PoolMetrics) public poolMetrics;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256[]) private priceHistory;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        if (msg.sender != owner) revert Unauthorized();
        _;
    }

    constructor(IPoolManager _poolManager) BaseHook(_poolManager) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _setupRole(ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        
        // Initialize default configurations
        defaultRebalanceThreshold = 10;    // 10% for non-stable pairs
        defaultTickRange = 120;            // ~1% for non-stable pairs
        defaultCooldownPeriod = 12 hours;  // 12 hours for non-stable pairs
        
        stableRebalanceThreshold = 2;      // 2% for stable pairs
        stableTickRange = 20;              // ~0.2% for stable pairs
        stableCooldownPeriod = 6 hours;    // 6 hours for stable pairs
    }

    function getHookPermissions() public pure override returns (Hooks.Permissions memory) {
        return Hooks.Permissions({
            beforeInitialize: false,
            afterInitialize: true,
            beforeAddLiquidity: true,
            afterAddLiquidity: true,
            beforeRemoveLiquidity: true,
            afterRemoveLiquidity: false,
            beforeSwap: false,
            afterSwap: true,
            beforeDonate: false,
            afterDonate: false,
            beforeSwapReturnDelta: false,
            afterSwapReturnDelta: false,
            afterAddLiquidityReturnDelta: false,
            afterRemoveLiquidityReturnDelta: false
        });
    }

    function _afterInitialize(
        address,
        PoolKey calldata key,
        uint160,
        int24 tick
    ) internal override returns (bytes4) {
        bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
        
        // Set pair type based on token addresses
        bool isStablePair = _isStablePair(key);
        pairConfigs[poolId].isStablePair = isStablePair;
        
        // Use appropriate configuration based on pair type
        (int24 rangeToUse, , ) = getConfigForPool(poolId);
        
        // Calculate initial range using library
        (int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper) = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateOptimalRange(
            tick,
            rangeToUse,
            0, // No volatility data yet
            isStablePair
        );
        
        positions[poolId] = Position({
            lowerTick: tickLower,
            upperTick: tickUpper,
            liquidity: 0,
            lastRebalance: 0,
            active: true
        });
        
        return BaseHook.afterInitialize.selector;
    }

    function _beforeAddLiquidity(
        address,
        PoolKey calldata key,
        IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams calldata params,
        bytes calldata
    ) internal override returns (bytes4) {
        if (params.liquidityDelta > 0) {
            bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
            positions[poolId].lowerTick = params.tickLower;
            positions[poolId].upperTick = params.tickUpper;
            positions[poolId].active = true;
        }
        return BaseHook.beforeAddLiquidity.selector;
    }

    function _afterAddLiquidity(
        address,
        PoolKey calldata key,
        IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams calldata params,
        BalanceDelta,
        BalanceDelta,
        bytes calldata
    ) internal override returns (bytes4, BalanceDelta) {
        if (params.liquidityDelta > 0) {
            bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
            Position storage position = positions[poolId];
            position.liquidity = uint128(uint256(params.liquidityDelta) + uint256(position.liquidity));
            
            emit PositionUpdated(poolId, position.lowerTick, position.upperTick, position.liquidity);
        }
        return (BaseHook.afterAddLiquidity.selector, BalanceDelta.wrap(0));
    }

    function _beforeRemoveLiquidity(
        address,
        PoolKey calldata key,
        IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams calldata params,
        bytes calldata
    ) internal override returns (bytes4) {
        if (params.liquidityDelta < 0) {
            bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
            Position storage position = positions[poolId];
            
            if (position.lowerTick == params.tickLower && 
                position.upperTick == params.tickUpper) {
                int256 absLiquidityDelta = params.liquidityDelta < 0 ? -params.liquidityDelta : params.liquidityDelta;
                if (uint256(absLiquidityDelta) >= uint256(position.liquidity)) {
                    position.active = false;
                    position.liquidity = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return BaseHook.beforeRemoveLiquidity.selector;
    }

    function _afterSwap(
        address,
        PoolKey calldata key,
        IPoolManager.SwapParams calldata params,
        BalanceDelta delta,
        bytes calldata
    ) internal override returns (bytes4, int128) {
        bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
        Position storage position = positions[poolId];
        
        // Skip if position is not active
        if (!position.active) {
            return (BaseHook.afterSwap.selector, 0);
        }

        // Get current tick and update metrics
        int24 currentTick = IMockPoolManager(address(poolManager)).getCurrentTick(poolId);
        _updateMetrics(poolId, params.amountSpecified, delta, currentTick);

        // Check cooldown period
        (, , uint256 cooldownPeriod) = getConfigForPool(poolId);
        if (block.timestamp < position.lastRebalance + cooldownPeriod) {
            return (BaseHook.afterSwap.selector, 0);
        }

        // Calculate price deviation
        int24 rangeMidpoint = (position.upperTick + position.lowerTick) / 2;
        int24 deviation = currentTick > rangeMidpoint ? 
            currentTick - rangeMidpoint : 
            rangeMidpoint - currentTick;
        
        uint256 deviationPct;
        uint256 tickRange = uint256(uint24(position.upperTick - position.lowerTick));
        if (tickRange > 0) {
            deviationPct = (uint256(uint24(deviation)) * 100) / tickRange;
        }
        
        // Check if price is outside current range
        bool isOutOfRange = currentTick <= position.lowerTick || currentTick >= position.upperTick;
        
        // Get pool metrics for decision making
        PoolMetrics memory metrics = poolMetrics[poolId];
        uint256 gasCost = metrics.avgGasPrice * 350000; // Conservative gas estimate
        
        // Use library to determine if rebalance is needed
        if (AutoRebalanceLibrary.shouldRebalance(
            deviationPct,
            pairConfigs[poolId].rebalanceThreshold,
            isOutOfRange,
            metrics.feesLast24h,
            gasCost,
            pairConfigs[poolId].isStablePair
        )) {
            _rebalance(key, currentTick);
        }
        
        return (BaseHook.afterSwap.selector, 0);
    }

    function _rebalance(PoolKey memory key, int24 currentTick) internal {
        bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
        Position storage position = positions[poolId];
        
        // Get configured range and metrics
        (int24 configuredRange, ,) = getConfigForPool(poolId);
        PoolMetrics memory metrics = poolMetrics[poolId];
        
        // Calculate new optimal range using library
        (int24 newLowerTick, int24 newUpperTick) = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateOptimalRange(
            currentTick,
            configuredRange,
            metrics.volatility24h,
            pairConfigs[poolId].isStablePair
        );
        
        // Update position
        position.lowerTick = newLowerTick;
        position.upperTick = newUpperTick;
        position.lastRebalance = block.timestamp;
        
        emit PositionUpdated(
            poolId,
            position.lowerTick,
            position.upperTick,
            position.liquidity
        );
    }

    function getConfigForPool(bytes32 poolId) public view returns (
        int24 range, 
        uint256 threshold,
        uint256 cooldown
    ) {
        PairConfig memory config = pairConfigs[poolId];
        
        if (config.isConfigured) {
            return (config.tickRange, config.rebalanceThreshold, config.cooldownPeriod);
        }
        
        // Return defaults based on pair type
        if (config.isStablePair) {
            return (stableTickRange, stableRebalanceThreshold, stableCooldownPeriod);
        } else {
            return (defaultTickRange, defaultRebalanceThreshold, defaultCooldownPeriod);
        }
    }

    function setPairConfig(
        PoolKey calldata key,
        bool isStablePair,
        int24 customTickRange,
        uint256 customRebalanceThreshold,
        uint256 customCooldownPeriod
    ) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {
        bytes32 poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key.toId()));
        
        // Validate configuration
        if (customTickRange < 10 || customTickRange > 2000) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (customRebalanceThreshold == 0 || customRebalanceThreshold > 50) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (customCooldownPeriod < 1 hours || customCooldownPeriod > 7 days) revert InvalidConfig();
        
        pairConfigs[poolId] = PairConfig({
            isConfigured: true,
            isStablePair: isStablePair,
            tickRange: customTickRange,
            rebalanceThreshold: customRebalanceThreshold,
            cooldownPeriod: customCooldownPeriod
        });
        
        emit PairConfigSet(poolId, isStablePair, customTickRange, customRebalanceThreshold);
    }

    function setDefaultConfig(
        uint256 newRebalanceThreshold,
        int24 newTickRange,
        uint256 newCooldownPeriod,
        uint256 newStableRebalanceThreshold,
        int24 newStableTickRange,
        uint256 newStableCooldownPeriod
    ) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {
        if (newRebalanceThreshold == 0 || newRebalanceThreshold > 50) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (newStableRebalanceThreshold == 0 || newStableRebalanceThreshold > 50) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (newTickRange < 10 || newTickRange > 2000) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (newStableTickRange < 10 || newStableTickRange > 2000) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (newCooldownPeriod < 1 hours || newCooldownPeriod > 7 days) revert InvalidConfig();
        if (newStableCooldownPeriod < 1 hours || newStableCooldownPeriod > 7 days) revert InvalidConfig();
        
        defaultRebalanceThreshold = newRebalanceThreshold;
        defaultTickRange = newTickRange;
        defaultCooldownPeriod = newCooldownPeriod;
        stableRebalanceThreshold = newStableRebalanceThreshold;
        stableTickRange = newStableTickRange;
        stableCooldownPeriod = newStableCooldownPeriod;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE) {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert InvalidConfig();
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    function _updateMetrics(
        bytes32 poolId,
        int256 amountSpecified,
        BalanceDelta delta,
        int24 currentTick
    ) internal {
        PoolMetrics storage metrics = poolMetrics[poolId];
        
        // Initialize metrics if first update
        if (metrics.lastUpdateTime == 0) {
            metrics.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp - HOUR;
            metrics.avgGasPrice = block.basefee;
        }
        
        // Update volume safely
        uint256 volume = uint256(amountSpecified < 0 ? -amountSpecified : amountSpecified);
        if (type(uint256).max - metrics.volumeLast24h >= volume) {
            metrics.volumeLast24h += volume;
        }
        
        // Update volatility metrics
        if (block.timestamp >= metrics.lastUpdateTime + HOUR) {
            // Update price history
            if (priceHistory[poolId].length >= PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH) {
                for (uint i = 0; i < PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH - 1; i++) {
                    priceHistory[poolId][i] = priceHistory[poolId][i + 1];
                }
                priceHistory[poolId][PRICE_HISTORY_LENGTH - 1] = uint256(uint24(currentTick));
            } else {
                priceHistory[poolId].push(uint256(uint24(currentTick)));
            }
            
            // Calculate volatility using library
            metrics.volatility24h = AutoRebalanceLibrary.calculateVolatility(priceHistory[poolId]);
            
            // Update last values
            metrics.lastTick = currentTick;
            metrics.lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp;
            metrics.avgGasPrice = (metrics.avgGasPrice * 9 + block.basefee) / 10;  // EMA of gas price
        }
        
        emit MetricsUpdated(
            poolId,
            metrics.volumeLast24h,
            metrics.feesLast24h,
            metrics.volatility24h,
            metrics.avgGasPrice
        );
    }

    // Helper to determine if a pair is stable based on token addresses
    function _isStablePair(PoolKey memory key) internal pure returns (bool) {

contract AutoRebalanceHook {

    address public admin;

        require(msg.sender == admin, "Not admin");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
    }

    function addStablecoin(address token) external onlyAdmin {
        stablecoinWhitelist[token] = true;
    }

    }

        address currency1 = Currency.unwrap(key.currency1);

    }
